title: Point Four Reset Block Battle (Michelle Grogan)
style: Electro-pop with funk and hip-hop influences. Features a prominent slap bass line, syncopated electronic drums with a crisp snare, and bright, staccato synth stabs. Male vocals are delivered in a rhythmic, spoken-word style with occasional melodic flourishes. The arrangement includes record scratches, vocal chops, and filtered synth sweeps. A clean electric guitar plays muted, rhythmic chords. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of G minor.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, electronic drums, record scratch]
[vocal chops: "ba-ba-ba-ba"]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic male vocals]
Four o'clock kitchen line battle
They speed up the ball at chess
Time to absorb not to swing
Reset is the answer best
[vocal chops: "ba-ba-ba-ba"]

[Chorus]
[synth stabs, driving beat]
Ball comes fast at the chest
No backswing is the test
Paddle out, face open, knees bent, feet still
Hoping vamos, vamos, absorb the pace
Uno, dos, tres

[Verse 2]
[slap bass, muted electric guitar]
Reset and reset, soft to the face
Reset and reset, slow the pace
Reset and reset, go with the flow
Points for reset block, points for reset block
Absorb the pace, absorb the pace
Points for reset block, points for reset block
Vamos amigos, win the race

[Bridge]
[record scratch, drum fill]
[vocal chops: "ba-ba-ba-ba"]

[Verse 3]
[rhythmic male vocals]
You swing back at the free throw
But the ball goes long over the cup
Get back up off the line
You give them more time, fine
Uno, dos, tres, feet still, no blunder, no thrill
Grip pressure two out of ten
Ball hits the face and floats again

[Chorus]
[full arrangement, synth stabs]
Reset block is the equalizer
When they speed up the realizer
Feet still, face open, soft hands
Ball floats back to the kitchen lines
Point four reset block, point four reset block
Absorb the pace, absorb the pace
Point four reset block, point four reset block
Vamos amigos, win the race

[Outro]
[slap bass, electronic drums]
[vocal chops: "ba-ba-ba-ba"]
Reset and reset, soft to the face
Reset and reset, slow the pace
[record scratch, final synth stab]
